messages.content: Generate an SVG of a pelican riding a bicycle

reasoning:
The user wants an SVG of a pelican riding a bicycle. I need to create a self-contained SVG. Let me design it carefully: bicycle with two wheels, frame, handlebars, seat; pelican sitting on the seat with its distinctive long beak with throat pouch, wings, legs on pedals.

Let me lay out coordinates. Canvas 400x300. Wheels at (110,220) and (290,220) radius 45. Frame connecting. Pelican body above seat around (180,120), head with long beak pointing forward/downward with pouch.

I'll use simple shapes: circles for wheels with spokes, lines for frame, body as ellipse/path, beak as a long triangle-ish shape with pouch curve, wing shape, legs going down to pedals.

Let me write it out.

Frame: rear wheel center (110,220), front wheel center (290,220). Bottom bracket at (200,220). Seat tube from bottom bracket up to seat at (170,140). Down tube from bottom bracket to head tube top (245,130). Top tube from seat (170,140) to head tube (245,130). Fork from head tube (245,130) to front wheel center (290,220). Chainstay from rear center to bottom bracket. Handlebars at (245,120) with a bar.

Pelican: body ellipse centered (180,120) rotated slightly. Head at (215,90). Long beak from head extending to (275,150) with pouch curve below. Wing on body. Tail at back left. Legs from body down to pedal at (200,220). Pedals: crank circle at bottom bracket with pedal positions.

Colors: pelican white/cream body, orange-yellow beak, bicycle dark gray/blue.

Let me craft the beak: pelican beak is long and pointed with a pouch underneath. Head at (215,88). Beak tip at (285,140). Upper mandible line from head to tip; pouch as curve bulging downward.

Path: M215,80 L285,138 L268,150 C240,160 220,140 212,112 Z — pouch shape.

Wing: path curving over body.

Legs: two lines from (190,145) to (205,215) with webbed feet small.

Add ground line maybe. Spokes: lines through wheel centers.

Let me write the SVG with reasonable detail, viewBox 0 0 400 300.

This SVG shows a cream-colored pelican perched on the saddle of a gray bicycle, its long orange beak with a pouch pointing forward over the handlebars, and its orange legs reaching down to the pedals. Wheels have spokes, and a ground line sets the scene.
